verdict.rationale: Runloop exposes a full REST API surface (Agents API, Devboxes, Storage Objects, Secrets, etc.) plus official SDKs in multiple languages, a CLI (rli), and llms.txt/markdown docs explicitly designed for AI-native consumption, all clearly documented for programmatic use. This strongly supports driving the product entirely through documented public APIs rather than only a UI. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s on standard OpenAPI paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API completeness/stability.
